title: Ball regular mouth mason jars 8oz
text: Ball regular mouth mason jars 8oz. These are super handy size (8 oz) and some with lids and rings.  They arrived well wrapped in a box along with other items I had ordered.  Great for quick pickles, keeping nuts fresher longer, sauces.  I don't actually 'can' so I wash and reuse the lids and rings - but spares are easy to purchase if you actually can.  The jars are clear glass.

product_metadata.title: Regular Mouth Mason Jar 8 oz [Set of 6] Canning Jars With Airtight lids and Bands - For Canning, Fermenting, Pickling - Glass jar, Microwave & Dishwasher Safe - Bundled With SEWANTA Jar Opener
features: 6 PACK CANNING JARS - 8-ounce jars perfect for canning, pickling, preserving, and fermenting fruits and veggies that can be canned and sealed for up to 18 months. Embossed measurement markings for precise filling. Label line for writing dates and identifying contents

DURABLE GLASS CONSTRUCTION - Made in America soda-lime glass, USDA approved and, Toxin-free ensuring food-grade quality. Heat-tempered durability for water bath canning, microwave, and dishwasher safe; clear glass for easy visibility; wide mouth for easy filling and washing.

AIRTIGHT SEAL - Hermetic Screw-in Suretight Time-tested sealing compound, ensures a quality air-tight seal with each lid. Refrigerate up to 3 weeks, for freeze capacity Fill up till 12 oz. freeze - fresh preserve and store up to 1 year; lid and bands allow you to test with dull sounds for the best seal.

FOOD PRESENTATION AND DIY - Create and serve beverage drinks, cocktails, smoothies, parfaits, desserts, salads, and overnight oats. Decor and craft with a vintage style jar for parties and displayed centerpieces, or as a unique gift. Spruce up decor arrangements with acrylic paint, flowers, etc.

MASON JARS - It has been around since the early 1900s and is the most recognized in home canning, representing everything you could want in a Mason jar with old-school American-made sturdy glass, supporting USA jobs
description: 8-OUNCE CANNING JAR- jars are perfect for canning all kinds of Special low-Acid food like Fruits, tomatoes, sauces, salsas jam & jellies, pickles . AIRTIGHT SEAL - The band when screwed down, An integral rubber ring on the underside of the lid creates a Leak Proof-Hermetic seal. . DULL SOUND LID - the lid create a dull-sound for freshness. While the bands are reusable, the lids are intended for single use when canning. The jar’s stackability helps you save space in lunch bags and in the fridge until you’re ready to eat or drink!
